ctx: אנטיגנוס איש סוכו: סוד המתנה של האב האוהב
en: Antigonus of Socho, a dignified sage with a grey beard, teaching a group of young boys in a courtyard near the Second Temple in Jerusalem at golden hour; incense smoke rising in the distance.

ctx: אנטיגנוס איש סוכו: סוד המתנה של האב האוהב
en: A Greek merchant in a colorful Hellenistic tunic jingling a pouch of gold coins in a Jerusalem alley, tempting a few curious Jewish boys who look unsure.

ctx: אנטיגנוס איש סוכו: סוד המתנה של האב האוהב
en: Antigonus sitting with the boys and telling a parable: in a dream-like inset, a loving son happily bringing a cup of cool water to his elderly father — serving out of love, not for a reward.

ctx: אנטיגנוס איש סוכו: סוד המתנה של האב האוהב
en: Shimon HaTzaddik, the elderly High Priest in white garments, warmly embracing his student Antigonus in front of the boys, tears of joy in his eyes, the Temple courtyard glowing behind.

ctx: שמעון בן שטח: לא לפנינו אתה עומד
en: The great Sanhedrin court in a stone hall: Shimon ben Shetach, a stern elderly sage, standing upright and pointing firmly, while a richly dressed Hasmonean king (Yannai) sits on a chair before the judges.

ctx: שמעון בן שטח: לא לפנינו אתה עומד
en: The other judges on both sides lowering their faces to the floor in fearful silence, while Shimon ben Shetach turns to them with disappointment; dramatic light from a high window.

ctx: הלל הזקן: הסוד מאוהל הכהן הגדול
en: Hillel the Elder, a gentle sage with a long white beard, teaching eighty attentive students in the great study hall in Jerusalem, warm lamp light.

ctx: הלל הזקן: הסוד מאוהל הכהן הגדול
en: In the desert camp of Israel at night: Aaron the High Priest (white robe, kind face) quietly entering a tent where a man sits sad, to make peace between two friends.

ctx: הלל הזקן: הסוד מאוהל הכהן הגדול
en: Two former friends meeting outside their tents at sunrise and embracing warmly, Aaron watching from a distance with a smile.
